test_title: PYST 31: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 22 Oct, 2024 - Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate idiom that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

The manager decided to __disclose a secret__ and address the issue at the team meeting.

options.text: hit the nail on the head

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. "spill the beans".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"spill the beans"** means to disclose a secret or reveal confidential information, often unintentionally. (राज़ खोल देना)

 
 
• **Example:** She accidentally spilled the beans about the surprise party during lunch.
 
 
 
• **"Bury the hatchet"** means to reconcile or make peace with someone after a conflict or disagreement. (मित्रता करना)
 
 
• **Example:** After years of rivalry, the two leaders decided to bury the hatchet and work together.
 
 
 
• **"Hit the nail on the head"** means to describe or do something exactly right or perfectly. (सटीक बात कहना)
 
 
• **Example:** When she suggested the new strategy, she really hit the nail on the head.
 
 
 
• **"Sweep it under the rug"** refers to hiding a problem or issue instead of addressing it. (समस्या को नजरअंदाज करना)
 
 
• **Example:** Instead of discussing their mistake, they tried to sweep it under the rug.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. "spill the beans".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Bury the hatchet** (मित्रता करना): To reconcile or make peace after a conflict or disagreement.

 
 
• **Example:** The two teams buried the hatchet after the heated match.
 
 
 
• **Hit the nail on the head** (सटीक बात कहना): To describe something accurately or do something perfectly.
 
 
• **Example:** Her explanation of the problem really hit the nail on the head.
 
 
 
• **Sweep it under the rug** (समस्या को नजरअंदाज करना): To hide or avoid dealing with a problem or issue.
 
 
• **Example:** They decided to sweep the financial issues under the rug instead of fixing them.
